name: Your Name
role_description: Your title, department, and research focus. Example: A tenured professor of computer science specializing in autonomous systems, with active NSF and DARPA grants and graduate students.
institution_note: Your institution (preprocessor/institution.py). domains: internal mail; related_domains: sister campuses the admissions filter treats as internal; safety_rail_domain: the EA never sends a first email outside it on its own; video: the platform and your personal link (zoom_link is read when video.link is empty); boilerplate_tokens/phrases: words and footer text that name the institution, never a person or an item; letterhead: where compiled letters find their template, and asset_dirs where an institution plugin keeps its letterhead style and logos. Every field falls back to the domain of your email.
bio_blurb: Brief professional bio for letter composition. Used when the EA drafts letters of recommendation or professional correspondence.
gmail_accounts_note: Gmail accounts the EA may draft from (gmail_client.py --email <addr>). Empty when you use Outlook only.
drive_accounts_note: Google accounts whose Docs and Drive files the EA may read, read only (drive_client.py; each signs in once with drive_client.py setup --email <addr>, docs/SETUP.md 'Google Drive'). Empty: the EA asks you to paste a document's text.
family_note: Optional. People the family-sync and rsvp skills may name: [{"name": "...", "relation": "spouse|child|...", "notes": "school, team, sitter, ..."}]. Their calendars go in calendar_accounts and in scheduling-preferences.json family_calendars.
